scope: Complete-pack claim remediation review of the two registered governing spec files, all nine generated PR-176 artifacts, and the one explicitly allowed preserved first claim-review result. No production code, unassigned evidence, or other sibling result was inspected.

summary.reason: The remediated pack quarantines every raw affine coefficient as a non-authoritative candidate diagnostic, reports the exact q-response non-identification as the controlling scientific terminal, preserves the failed covariance self-consistency gate on a separate validation axis, carries complete consistent metadata, kills the registered raw-use and claim-promotion mutations, and explicitly refuses candidate self-authorization pending external adjudication.

assumptions: The frozen parent spec and its hash-bound additive erratum jointly govern the remediated result pack.

The covariance self-consistency gate is a validation axis separate from the parent spec's ordered scientific terminal router; its failure blocks an accepted covariance-validated divergence measurement but does not manufacture or erase the independently registered q-response authority non-identification.

A preregistered authority-driven NON_INFORMATIVE_Q_RESPONSE_UNAVAILABLE result may satisfy the dependency success semantic under spec lines 50-55 and 256-264, provided no coefficient or q result is promoted and the failed validation axis remains visible.
Integrity and mutation receipts produced by the candidate generation do not constitute independent scientific closeout authorization.

prior_finding_dispositions.title: Candidate coefficient language now prevents rejected divergence outputs from becoming an accepted measurement

evidence.detail: The additive correction preserves the failed covariance gate on a separate validation axis and requires raw affine coefficients to remain computed candidate diagnostics, not an accepted covariance-validated divergence measurement.

All registered rank/information response gates pass, while coefficient_rows_are_accepted_measurement is false, coefficient_status names the failed covariance gate, and physical_interpretation is candidate_only.
The theta rows are named divergence_candidate_coefficients, divergence_channel_accepted_measurement is false, and the interpretation explicitly emits no accepted covariance-validated measurement.
Allowed and mandatory language is limited to internal conditional candidate diagnostics and q-response non-identification; the card denies an accepted measurement and records the exact terminal.

prior_finding_dispositions.closure_reason: The numerical rows remain byte-visible for reproducibility but every authoritative consumer-facing surface labels them candidate-only and explicitly rejects accepted-measurement status.

prior_finding_dispositions.title: Scientific terminal, validation failure, and dependency-success semantics are now orthogonal and explicit

evidence.detail: The frozen contract permits authority-driven non-informative success, nulls q values without signed CF4-window response authority, and routes unavailable signed q responses to NON_INFORMATIVE_Q_RESPONSE_UNAVAILABLE after rank/information gates.
The erratum explicitly separates the frozen covariance self-consistency miss from the registered rank/condition/information router and preserves it as FROZEN_COVARIANCE_SELF_CONSISTENCY_GATE_FAILED.
Deterministic injections pass, covariance self-consistency fails, physical covariance validation is false, and the exact failed validation axis is emitted.

The pack separately reports rejected measurement status, null q/significance/family/transfer fields, reproducible scientific result, success_dependency_satisfied=true, exact q-response terminal and reason, and the failed validation axis.
Both signed response bridges and matched covariance remain unavailable, scientific_q_use is false for all formula-only rows, and no cross-channel interval is evaluated.
The canonical card leads with the failed covariance validation and candidate-only limitation, then names unavailable signed responses as the controlling registered cross-channel terminal.

prior_finding_dispositions.closure_reason: The prior blanket concern that success was being derived from a failed injection no longer applies. Success is derived only from the preregistered q-response authority non-identification; the failed covariance validation independently prevents measurement acceptance and is not presented as scientific non-identification.

prior_finding_dispositions.title: Candidate self-authorization is now denied rather than asserted as satisfied

evidence.detail: The manifest content-addresses all eight child artifacts, states the no-self-authorization policy, leaves the independent receipt null, and records PENDING_EXTERNAL_ADJUDICATION.
Source authority and raw-use fields are candidate-pack evidence only; raw_reconstruction_values_used is empty and both spec hashes are bound.

The candidate mutation receipt reports source reseal, raw reconstruction truth, q/covariance self-authorization, terminal promotion, success denial, and public-use promotion mutations killed; it is not counted here as external authorization.

prior_finding_dispositions.closure_reason: The first review explicitly allowed the check to remain pending or unverified until an independent receipt exists. The remediated manifest adopts that fail-closed option and no longer presents candidate integrity as completed independent authorization. This reviewer envelope may be consumed by the main adjudicator but is not silently inserted into the candidate manifest.

passing_checks.detail: All twelve assignment-required inputs match their registered SHA-256 values. The manifest's eight child hashes and sizes match the assigned on-disk artifacts.
Every consumer-facing coefficient surface is explicitly candidate-only; accepted-measurement fields are false and the covariance validation failure remains visible.
The exact terminal is NON_INFORMATIVE_Q_RESPONSE_UNAVAILABLE because both separately signed CF4-window response bridges are unavailable; q values and the cross-channel interval remain null.
Dependency success is tied to the registered reproducible q-response authority non-identification, while the covariance validation failure separately blocks accepted-measurement status.

All nine generated artifacts carry identical OBSSTAT/obsstat ownership and scope, conditional C3, standard_internal, public_use=false, transfer_source=none, config and input hashes, sky/mask/covariance/null status, seven caveats, generating command, and content-bound Git/worktree state.
Vpds/Vpwf/Vpec occur only in the governing prohibition and raw-truth mutation; raw_reconstruction_values_used is empty, and the raw-reconstruction-truth mutation is reported killed.
The candidate pack does not claim independent closeout authority: receipt is null and status is PENDING_EXTERNAL_ADJUDICATION.

No positive detection, significance, acceleration, global-tilt, cosmological-anisotropy, geometry, Bianchi-family, native/external-transfer-validation, leakage-immunity, or physical-covariance-validation claim appears. Hits are forbidden-use entries, explicit negations, null fields, or familywise statistical terminology.
OBSSTAT owns the raw observable coefficient extraction and authority-availability diagnostic only; no HTT posterior, MIO certificate, BASS-native result, or TSC/Teff ownership is created.

claims.claim: Raw affine coefficients at the three registered radii
claims.evidence: artifact plus deterministic and covariance-propagation checks
claims.risk: The frozen covariance self-consistency gate failed.

claims.evidence: two separately typed signed response authorities are unavailable and q fields are null
claims.risk: Formula-only coefficients could be misread as authenticated response bridges.
claims.required_fix: none; retain formula-only and scientific_q_use=false qualifiers

claims.risk: A future consumer could mistake integrity for authorization.
claims.required_fix: main adjudicator must bind an independent result before changing pending status

tests_to_run: No additional production test is required by this read-only claim assignment; the main adjudicator should validate and hash this result envelope before consuming it.
artifacts_status_updates_needed: Do not rewrite this reviewer result or the preserved first FAIL.
Keep independent_closeout_authorization pending unless the main adjudicator explicitly binds an independent review receipt under its owning closeout transaction.
risks_and_kill_switches: Any relabeling of candidate coefficients as an accepted measurement reopens F-PR176-FINAL-CLAIM-001.
Any success rationale derived from the failed covariance validation rather than q-response authority non-identification reopens F-PR176-FINAL-CLAIM-002.
Any replacement of PENDING_EXTERNAL_ADJUDICATION with a candidate-generated approval reopens F-PR176-FINAL-CLAIM-003.
Any non-null q estimate, q interval, significance, theta apex, family/geometry field, native-transfer field, or matched covariance without new authenticated authority fails the claim firewall.
remaining_risks: This is a bounded claim/provenance review, not an independent numerical replay or production-code audit.
The candidate mutation report is treated as useful integrity evidence but not as independent closeout authorization.
The main adjudicator must preserve the explicit pending-authorization boundary when assembling the final closeout receipt.
